The '''Viamarr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Viamarr 4]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
